normal.name: schamspeare
normal.text: Well, I went 4 and 1 today, but it felt like it required a rather significant amount of concentration and nothing came easily. The whole experience today was kind of un-game-like in an odd way. I guess that's because you're basically parsing text that tells you how to do arithmetic. (And lord, what a lot of text!) Whatever is thematic — the idea of casting spells, for example, or these creatures on the cards — barely enters your thoughts. A little sad. #mtg #magicthegathering #games

normal.name: Jeremy Stephens
normal.text: Persona 5 had been sitting in my stack of games to play for a while so I've been working through it finally. It had been a while since I played a JRPG. After playing 20 hours I felt like I barely started. I'm at around 30 now and things are picking up. I'm pretty much hooked at this point. All my Final Fantasy experience has kicked in and now I must complete everything. #gaming
